T: Pyramids, Sardinia and a table under the sea.
D: Bond teams up with a Soviet agent to find out who is stealing nuclear submarines.
P: Serve the snacks when Bond visits Sheikh Hosein in his tent in the Egyptian desert.
S: Egyptian falafel, served in the desert tent by an old Cambridge friend

Soak 250g dried split broad beans overnight. Drain and blitz with an onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch each of coriander and parsley, 2 spring onions, cumin, ground coriander, chilli flakes and salt to a coarse green paste and chill. Stir in half a tsp bicarb, shape 20 flat patties and press in sesame. Fry at 175C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with tahini whisked with lemon juice and water, and warm pita.
Cairo nightclub food, while Bond waits for his contact

Soak 12 skewers. Knead 500g lamb mince with a grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, parsley, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, allspice, salt and pepper, mould onto the skewers and chill for 20 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with squeezed grated cucumber and mint. Brush the kofta with oil and chargrill for 8 minutes, turning, and serve with the yoghurt.
M: seafood from the waters around Atlantis

Purge 1kg clams in salted water for 30 minutes. Heat 800ml fish stock with saffron. Fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and a chilli in 3 tbsp olive oil, add 250g cherry tomatoes and cook until collapsing. Toast 300g fregola in the pan for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time over 12 minutes. Add the clams, cover and cook for 5 minutes until open. Finish with parsley, lemon zest and the rest of the oil.
The island's feast, crackling and potatoes, served at Atlantis
Pork shoulder roasted slow with rosemary, garlic and fennel seed until the crackling shatters, with potatoes in the drippings.
W: Sardinia's sweet, fried and soaked in honey on the coast where Bond stays

Knead 250g plain flour, 40g soft butter, a pinch of salt and 110ml warm water to a smooth dough and rest for 30 minutes. Mix 200g squeezed fior di latte, 50g grated pecorino and a lemon's zest and press into 4 discs. Roll the dough thin, cut 8 rounds of 12cm, sandwich a disc of cheese between two and seal with a fork. Fry in oil at 175C for 3 minutes a side until blistered and golden, drain and pour over 4 tbsp warm honey.

K: Sardinia's own berry liqueur, poured for Stromberg's guests
Fill 4 wine glasses with ice. Add 30ml myrtle liqueur to each, top with chilled sparkling wine and a splash of soda, and finish with a twist of lemon peel and 3 blueberries.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the broad beans overnight, at least 12 hours; blitz the paste up to 1 day ahead and chill; fry just before serving

steps.text: Soak the broad beans in plenty of cold water overnight.
Drain well and blitz with the onion, garlic, coriander, parsley, spring onions, cumin, ground coriander, chilli and most of the salt to a coarse green paste. Chill for 30 minutes.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, water and the last of the salt until smooth.
Stir the bicarb into the paste, shape into 20 small flat patties and press the tops into the sesame seeds.
Heat the oil to 175C in a deep heavy pan.
Fry in batches for about 4 minutes, turning, until deep green inside and crisp outside.
Warm the pita and serve with the ta'ameya and tahini sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape the kofta up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; soak the skewers for 30 minutes; grill just before serving

steps.text: Soak the skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Knead the lamb with the onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, allspice, salt and pepper for 2 minutes.
Divide into 12 and mould each into a long sausage around a skewer.
Chill for 20 minutes.
Squeeze the cucumber dry and mix with the yoghurt and mint.
Brush the kofta with the oil and cook on a hot chargrill pan or barbecue for 8 minutes, turning, until browned and just cooked.
Serve with the yoghurt.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the kofta up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry just before serving

steps.text: Pulse the chickpeas and walnuts to a coarse crumb, then mix with the feta, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, allspice, salt and pepper.
Shape into 12 fat fingers.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Squeeze the cucumber dry and mix with the yoghurt and mint.
Fry the kofta in the oil in a frying pan for 8 minutes, turning, until browned all over.
Serve with the yoghurt.

dishes.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; purge the clams 30 minutes ahead and keep them cold, damp and covered

steps.text: Soak the clams in cold salted water for 30 minutes to purge any sand, then drain.
Heat the stock with the saffron and keep it hot.
Fry the garlic and chilli in 3 tbsp of the oil for a minute, then add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until collapsing.
Add the fregola and toast for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 12 minutes until just tender.
Add the clams, cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until opened. Throw out any that stay shut.
Stir in the parsley, lemon zest and the rest of the oil and season.
Rest for 2 minutes and serve in warm bowls.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; dice the zucchini and grate the pecorino a few hours ahead

steps.text: Heat the stock with the saffron and keep it hot.
Fry the garlic, chilli and zucchini in 3 tbsp of the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until collapsing.
Add the fregola and toast for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 12 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the pecorino, parsley, lemon zest and the rest of the oil and season.
Rest for 2 minutes and serve in warm bowls.

dishes.make_ahead: Score and salt the pork up to 1 day ahead, uncovered in the fridge so the skin dries; roast on the day

steps.text: Pound the fennel seeds, garlic, rosemary leaves and salt with a little oil and rub into the meat, not the skin. Salt the skin well.
Roast at 240C until the skin starts to blister.
Turn the oven to 170C, add the potatoes tossed in oil around the pork and roast until tender.
Rest the pork, then carve with the crackling and serve with the potatoes and lemon.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and seal the pastries up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled on floured baking paper; fry just before serving

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
fior di latte, torn and squeezed dry

steps.text: Knead the flour, butter, salt and warm water to a smooth dough, wrap and rest for 30 minutes.
Mix the fior di latte, pecorino and lemon zest and press into 4 flat discs.
Roll the dough thin on a floured bench and cut 8 rounds of 12cm. Sandwich each cheese disc between two rounds, press out the air and seal the edges well with a fork.
Heat the oil to 175C in a wide deep pan.
Fry 2 at a time for about 3 minutes a side until blistered and golden, then drain.
Warm the honey, pour over the hot seadas and serve straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the sparkling wine and soda for at least 2 hours ahead; build in the glass to order

steps.text: Fill 4 wine glasses with ice.
Add 30ml of the myrtle liqueur to each.
Top with the sparkling wine, then a splash of soda.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add 3 blueberries.

af.make_ahead: Make and chill the blueberry syrup up to 1 week ahead; build in the glass to order

steps.text: Simmer the blueberries for the syrup with the sugar, water, juniper and bay for 5 minutes, crushing the berries.
Take off the heat and steep for 15 minutes.
Strain and chill for 30 minutes.
Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and add 2 tbsp of the syrup to each.
Top with the sparkling grape juice, then a splash of soda.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add 3 blueberries.
